description: Look up a booking's status, dates, room, totals and cancellation terms. With a connected Tell & Go account this works for any of the traveller's own bookings; call list_my_bookings to find their ids. Without one it works only for a booking created in this same MCP session. Read the terms as given: a paid booking keeps a processing fee when cancelled in its refundable period, so never describe a cancellation as free.

booking_id.description: booking_id returned by start_booking (its booking_reference is also accepted)

journey_id.description: Continuity handle returned as journey_id in previous Tell & Go tool results. Always pass the most recent journey_id you have received in this conversation.

name: get_booking

outputSchema.description: Status of a booking created in this connection.

confirmation_number.description: The supplier's own reference, for Tell & Go support only. It is not a number from the hotel; give the guest `reference`.

journey_id.description: Continuity handle. Pass it back as journey_id on the next Tell & Go tool call. Treat it as confidential: it also unlocks get_booking for bookings made under it.

payment.description: Payment status, amount, currency and paid_at.

status.description: pending_payment, processing, confirmed, cancelled, completed or failed.

title: Check a Tell & Go booking
